# Digital Future NH

> A non-partisan New Hampshire political action committee supporting candidates who back digital property, sound money, and the energy and compute infrastructure that powers the digital future. Granite-made. Future-built.

## About
Digital Future NH (legal name: NH Digital Future PAC) backs New Hampshire candidates who defend digital property rights, sound money, and the energy and data-center capacity behind the digital economy. The PAC scores legislators on signal bills and supports a pro-technology, pro-liberty agenda in the Granite State.
